revisions.text:
Mid-Boss: You're too late, Deadlock. I've already won.

Deadlock: I don't think so. I'm just getting started.

Mid-Boss: We'll see about that. Prepare to face your doom!

Deadlock: Bring it on! I've faced tougher opponents than you.

Mid-Boss: Don't get cocky, Deadlock. I'm the strongest fighter in the galaxy.

Deadlock: We'll see about that. I have a few tricks up my sleeve.
